purpose: Preserve the user-confirmed API-sourced UNI metrics separately from derived interpretations. Codex has not inspected the original API payloads or field-level timestamps.

reference_facts_not_verified_as_current_.fact: Uniswap v4 was announced live on 2025-01-31; later development does not imply it was not yet launched.
The original UNI issuance plan describes 1 billion tokens at genesis and a possible 2% annual inflation design after four years.
The published UNI contract source includes a mint function subject to minter, timing and cap checks; the minter's state at the report time is not established here.

quality_flags: The report combines 37.9% of nominal maximum supply with 267 million tokens calculated from total supply; these denominators must not be mixed.
The 112 million token gap between nominal maximum and reported total supply is not an unlock schedule; burned and unminted amounts require separate verification.
The 30-day TVL rise does not establish net deposits or a causal explanation for UNI price changes.
The 30-day liquidation totals alone do not establish a short squeeze as the cause of the reported price rise.
Top-holder identities and sellable concentration cannot be confirmed from shortened addresses and an unknown denominator.

The user confirms the quantitative metrics were fetched through APIs. The report time is not a per-field API timestamp, and original responses and endpoint definitions have not been supplied to Codex.
excluded_from_jev_input_until_supported: 38% or 267 million UNI will be unlocked and sold
TVL growth caused the price increase
A short squeeze caused the price increase
UNI should be bought only after a pullback
A high risk label predicts a negative 7-day or 30-day return
minimum_missing_evidence: For an independently reproducible accuracy study: original API responses or archived endpoint records with field-level timestamps and source URLs
Verified supply, burned amount and dated future unlock or governance release events
Spot trading liquidity and historical prices at the decision cutoff
TVL net inflows, trading fees and actual UNI value-capture mechanism at the cutoff
Complete holder addresses, balance denominator and block height
Explicit timezone for the 2026-09-20 13:35 report time
